about: Real-mode check (FALLBACK step 8b). Create T/k/<kitFiles>, T/r (git init), T/r/<repoFiles>, and the user file. Run with cwd T/r/sub and MB_KIT=T/k. POSIX: HOME=T/h, XDG_CONFIG_HOME unset, user file at T/h/.config/acme/config.json. Windows: APPDATA=T\a, user file at T\a\acme\config.json. T/r/sub/.acme/config.json is a decoy that must be ignored.
